column1: # Confirmation table for avocado_safe_disk_confirm. Tab-separated; the header row is required.
# force: the AVOCADO_PROVISION_FORCE text, or <unset> (variable absent) or <empty> (set to "").
# terminal: yes when stdin is a terminal, no when it is not (a pipe carrying the right path counts as no).
#   skip     exit 0, no retype, prints "confirmation skipped: AVOCADO_PROVISION_FORCE=1"
#   retype   the exact target is typed on the terminal; exit 0 on a match, nonzero otherwise
#   proceed  exit 0, no retype asked (dry run, or the legacy row: no terminal and no force signal)
